info.name: Open Sauce - Developer 1 Endpoints (Auth, Profile, Comments, Suggestions)
info.description:
### Open Sauce REST API - Developer 1 Endpoints Collection

This collection contains all API endpoints assigned to **Developer 1**, covering:
- **Authentication** (Register, Login, Logout)
- **User Profile** (View authenticated profile & receipts)
- **Comments** (List comments, Add comment, Like/Unlike comments)
- **Suggestions** (List suggestions, Add suggestion snapshot, Update suggestion snapshot, Like/Unlike suggestions, Approve suggestion)

---

### 🚀 Quick Start Guide
1. Make sure your local Laravel backend is running (`php artisan serve` on port `8000`).
2. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default is `http://localhost:8000`).
3. Execute **Auth -> Register a new user** or **Auth -> Login**.
   - *Note:* The test scripts in Register and Login will **automatically** extract and save the Sanctum Bearer token into the `{{authToken}}` collection variable, so you don't need to copy-paste tokens manually!
4. Use all protected endpoints freely; they automatically inherit `Authorization: Bearer {{authToken}}`.

item.name: 1. Authentication
item.description: Authentication endpoints for user registration, login, and token revocation.

request.description:
**Public Endpoint**
Creates a new user account.

**Validation Rules:**
- `name`: string, required, max 255
- `email`: string, required, valid email, max 255, unique in `users` table
- `password`: string, required, min 8 chars, must contain letters and numbers

**Automation:**
Upon a successful `201 Created` response, the bearer token is saved to the `{{authToken}}` collection variable automatically.

response.name: 422 Validation Error

request.description:
**Public Endpoint**
Authenticates an existing user and returns a Laravel Sanctum bearer token.

**Rate Limiting:** `6 requests / minute`.

**Automation:**
Upon a successful `200 OK` response, the bearer token is saved to `{{authToken}}` automatically.

**Protected Endpoint**
Revokes the current Sanctum token used for this session (DEC-017).

Returns `204 No Content` on success (DEC-018).

**Protected Endpoint**
Returns the authenticated user's profile information along with all recipes (`receipts`) created by them.

response.name: 200 OK (With Recipes)
response.body:

    "user_id": 1,
    "name": "Sara Ahmed",

item.name: 3. Comments
item.description: Endpoints for viewing, creating, and liking/unliking comments on recipes.

item.name: View all comments for a recipe

request.description:
**Protected Endpoint**
Returns paginated comments for the specified recipe (`receipt_id`).

Includes comment author details, likes count, and whether the authenticated user liked the comment (`is_liked`).

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
**Protected Endpoint**
Adds a new comment to a recipe.

**Validation:**
- `receipt_id`: integer, required
- `text`: string, required, max 1000 characters (DEC-010)

response.name: 201 Created

request.description:
**Protected Endpoint**
Likes a comment. Idempotent: repeated likes return `201 Created` with `is_liked: true` without duplicating records (DEC-011).

**Protected Endpoint**
Removes the authenticated user's like from a comment.

item.name: 4. Suggestions
item.description: Endpoints for recipe modifications and fork snapshots (Suggestions).

item.name: View all suggestions for a recipe

request.description:
**Protected Endpoint**
Returns paginated suggestions for a recipe along with their cloned ingredients and instructions snapshots, user info, likes count, and approval status.

response.name: 200 OK

request.description:
**Protected Endpoint**
Creates a suggestion on a recipe.

**How it works:**
1. Client provides `receipt_id` and summary `text`.
2. Backend automatically **clones** the target recipe's current ingredients and instructions into this suggestion snapshot inside a DB transaction.
3. The original recipe remains completely unmodified.

response.name: 201 Created

request.description:
**Protected Endpoint**
Edits and updates the complete ingredients and instructions snapshot of a pending suggestion.

**Rules:**
- Only the suggestion author can update it (`403 Forbidden` for other users).
- Approved suggestions cannot be updated (`403 Forbidden`).
- The request body contains the complete new snapshot of ingredients and instructions.

response.name: 200 OK
403 Forbidden (Not Author or Already Approved)

request.description:
**Protected Endpoint**
Likes a suggestion. Idempotent: duplicate likes return `201 Created` with `is_liked: true`.

**Protected Endpoint**
Removes the authenticated user's like from a suggestion.

**Protected Endpoint (Recipe Owner Only)**
Approves a suggestion.

**Business Logic:**
- Only the owner of the recipe can approve suggestions targeting it (`403 Forbidden` for anyone else).
- When approved, the suggestion's ingredients & instructions snapshot atomically replace the recipe's current ingredients & instructions (DEC-020).

response.name: 403 Forbidden (Non-Owner Approval)
